verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform, not an equity-management or cap-table product, so an employee equity portal showing grants, vesting, strike price and outcome modeling is outside its product category. Generic features such as Artifacts or file creation are not this capability and do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an employee, I get my own portal showing my grants, vesting progress, strike price, and what my equity could be worth under different outcomes
